chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about the palm branch that is with the deceased, so he said:
"It benefits the believer and the disbeliever."

key_terms.ٱلْجَرِيدَةِ: the palm branch placed with the deceased

ai.seo_question: Does the palm branch placed with the deceased benefit only the believer or also the disbeliever?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the palm branch placed with the deceased brings benefit. The Imam عليه السلام says that this benefit extends to both the believer and the disbeliever, indicating a funerary practice connected to the state of the dead.
